Jade CSM: Heads-up: NovaCare trial org went from ~12k tokens/day to ~10 tokens yesterday. Procurement put the pilot on hold. Flagging renewal risk.
Ravi AE: They paused after a security committee call. Main asks: KMS integration detail, SSO flow, and proof of latency on their bulk summarization job. EdgeAI was demoed last week.
Jade CSM: Also got a note from their data scientist about inconsistent entity extraction and a couple hallucination cases when summarizing long threads. They want sample outputs + fixes.
Nina Eng: Can we get a failing request id and sample prompt? I can check model pinning, kv cache TTL, and batching config. Might be an LRU eviction pattern.
Jade CSM: Sample prompt (sanitized):
```
Extract named entities and assign urgency to customer support tickets from last 90 days.
```
Request id: rc_20240614_NC_99 (from their logs).
Marco Solutions: I uploaded a short one-pager comparing Dedicated+KMS vs EdgeAI on latency/cost/ops: https://redwood.internal/novacare-ops (internal). Can tailor to air-gapped if asked.
Ravi AE: Proposed play: 1) 20-30m technical sync with their ML lead this week; 2) send KMS + SSO checklist and SOC2 notes; 3) offer a 7-day dedicated trial with lowered commit + instrumentation; 4) collect 5 failing prompts and outputs for eval. Thoughts? :+1:
Jade CSM: +1. I'll gather 5 prompt samples and the hallucination examples by Wed EOD and loop exec sponsor.
Nina Eng: I'll run perf tests tomorrow on their pinned model and a small-quantized variant, capture p50/p95/p99 and token throughput. Will attach traces to CS-9004.
healthbot: Health-scan: account NovaCare (org_id: nc_440) flagged USAGE_DROP; risk_score=22/100; flagged_by=engagement-monitor.
Marco Solutions: If EdgeAI is pushing air-gapped, we should prep Private deployment notes and migration estimate. Otherwise Dedicated+KMS is quick. I'll draft both briefs.
Ravi AE: I'll draft the re-engagement email and include procurement + security. Jade, once you upload the prompts I'll append logs and Nina's perf summary.
Jade CSM: Quick ask for the sync: confirm whether security is focused on KMS-only or full air-gap. That determines which brief to send.
Ravi AE: Scheduling now. Will post meeting time and attendees.
Jade CSM: Thanks team — will update after the call. :white_check_mark:
